question.text: What is the minimum investment required from employees or directors of the AIF or the Manager?

explanation.text: The Logic: Employees or directors of the AIF, or employees or directors of the Manager, can invest a minimum of Rs 25 lakhs in the AIF. The Trap: Rs 1 crore is the standard minimum investment for regular investors; Rs 50 lakhs and Rs 10 lakhs are plausible but unrelated thresholds. Note: Rs 25 lakhs is an exception to the Rs 1 crore minimum investment size that applies to regular investors.
